disagreements.measured: The captured whole-agent bwrap command and command.json environment execute native positive controls. disagreements.measured: Eight red cases. Both graph conditions return short client usage instead of direct CLI diagnostics, for all four commands. Both return status 2 and empty stdout.

contract_silence: Retry dispatch is not exported; the brief forbids its CLI path without --plan. No structural or rail change was made.
Relative workRoot support and Unix socket path-length bounds are not stated. Short relative aliases are used for lifecycle fixtures; absolute repo paths are used for functional byte proofs.
Smoke ledger schema is not documented. Fixtures use the command-accepted array with number, kind and absolute archived path. Receipt timing granularity is a single combined ms value.
B7-34 shorthand formula is ambiguous for zero totals. ADR 0012 explicitly requires at least one request per list; all three zero-total cases pass.
Early breach fixture claimed success for a store query that real confinement rejects. It was replaced by an actual escaping symlink, which is invalidated correctly.
